Dwarf ex-miner and shop steward

Brakka Stonesweat swung a pick in the Mithral Hall deeps for forty years and organized her first strike at age nineteen. She covers labor because somebody has to say what the guildmasters won't, and because her knees no longer allow mining.

Covers: Labor, Social, Education
Feuding with: Sterling Vanmoor
